title: Distribution Steering via Sliced Optimal Transport Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.12828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distribution steering seeks feedback laws that drive the state law of a dynamical system between prescribed initial and terminal distributions. Optimal transport provides a natural geometric approach, but its implementation generally requires a transport map or coupling in the full state space. Sliced optimal transport avoids this full-dimensional construction through one-dimensional projections. Yet, the resulting projected maps specify only directional displacements and do not by themselves prescribe a realizable feedback law. To this end, we develop a finite-horizon control framework based on sliced optimal transport. At each sampling instant, a projected optimal transport map defines a directional terminal condition, whose minimum-energy realization yields a randomized single-direction controller. translated_title: 基于切片最优传输控制的分布引导
translated_abstract: 分布引导旨在寻找驱动动态系统状态分布在给定初始分布和终端分布之间演化的反馈律。最优传输提供了一种自然的几何方法，但其实现通常需要在全状态空间中构建传输映射或耦合。切片最优传输通过一维投影避免了这种全维度构造。然而，由此产生的投影映射仅指定了方向位移，并未自行规定可实现的反馩律。为此，我们开发了一个基于切片最优传输的有限时域控制框架。在每个采样时刻，一个投影最优传输映射定义了方向终端条件，其最小能量实现产生一个随机单方向控制器。对投影方向进行平均可得到确定性切片反馈。对于单积分器动力学，平均反馈矩阵...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于切片最优传输的有限时域控制框架，通过一维投影和方向平均实现分布引导，避免了全状态空间传输映射的构建，并生成了可实现的反馩律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a finite-horizon control framework based on sliced optimal transport, which achieves distribution steering via one-dimensional projections and directional averaging, avoiding full-dimensional transport map construction and yielding implementable feedback laws.
